page.overview:
Who is Lady with the Red Parasol?

The Lady with the Red Parasol, whose real name is Tzu San Niang, is a fictional character created by Fantasy Flight Games for their Arkham Horror Cthulhu Mythos setting.

The Lady is a beautiful woman of apparently Asian descent, who is never seen without her signature red parasol, which is likely one of the powerful magical artefacts known as "Keys." She is a senior member of the Red Coterie, a secret society dedicated to obtaining the Keys as part of an unknown agenda.

Although capable of wielding significant mystical powers, such as the ability to psychically reach through walls and attack her enemies (: "City of Waking Dreams"), she is not immune to magic herself, as seen when a blast from the Key known as the Xiamen Bi left her visibly shocked and unwell (: "A Forty Grain Weight of Nephrite").

The Lady is known to be a formidable figure in the Shanghai criminal underworld, as well as amongst its upper echelons (: "City of Waking Dreams"), but has been seen to operate in as diverse locations as Cuba (: "Brother Bound") and San Francisco, California (: "A Forty Grain Weight of Nephrite").
